content.text: All tests pass and typecheck is clean. Let's also lint.

The card ids already used `nanoid` (`src/decks/deck-repository.ts`), but the package ships ESM-only and Jest's default `transformIgnorePatterns` (from the `jest-expo` preset) excluded it from transformation, so every test importing `deck-repository.ts` failed with a `SyntaxError: Cannot use import statement outside a module`.

Fix: overrode `transformIgnorePatterns` in `jest.config.js` with the `jest-expo` preset's default list plus `nanoid`, so Babel transforms it like the other RN-ecosystem ESM packages already allow-listed there. Full test suite (95 tests) and `tsc --noEmit` both pass now.
